items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: Ehrlich said that you had some kind of deal with Atlantic, I think it was.

ctx.x: We leased it to Atlantic Records. You did? No. Well we didn't. How that worked out? We did something.
Ehrlich said that you had some kind of deal with Atlantic, I think it was.

Yeah, but that wasn't the one that we had to deal with. This came back, we were late in the game, that with this Walker fellow, we had a record of something called, uh, uh, Pelican, or was it Pelican? We had a group, some of the same people called Pelican, and he had his own label, the Walker fellow had his own label. Eli Walker, is it Eli Walker? Eli Walker, that's him. I was saying Sigmo, where that came from. Sigmo was a bass player. Uh, Walker did, no, I'm ahead of myself again. We did Barefootin' for this…
